title: pop-choice-optimizer-telemetry-fusion-safety-fences
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Goal: Build a robust pop (region/POP) selection component that fuses p50/p95 latency telemetry with link-level health signals (packet loss, error-rate) and economic penalties to choose tiered routing with safe fallback to model variants. This ticket implements the algorithmic evaluator ("pop-choice optimizer") and integrates it with the region-decider interface so that routing decisions respect latency SLOs, per-customer tier preferences, and avoid oscillation during transient network events.
spec: Inputs: recent sliding-windowed telemetry for each POP (p50, p95, token-rate adjusted), per-link packet loss EWMA, ingress error-rate, and capacity headroom. Outputs: ranked POP list with reason codes and a fallback confidence score. Algorithm: 1) normalize latency percentiles by recent request size and quantize into cost buckets; 2) compute link-quality penalty from packet loss + error-rate with decay; 3) combine into a composite score: score = alpha * latency_cost + beta * link_penalty + gamma * tier_penalty, where coefficients are tunable via runtime flags. Safety fences: - if p95 exceeds p95_threshold OR link_penalty > link_threshold -> mark POP degraded and lower weight by a categorical multiplier; - hysteresis window with adaptive decay to prevent rapid flip-flopping. Integration: expose decision API for router with fields {primary_pop, fallback_sequence, decision_metadata}. Telemetry ingestion: use existing POP metrics topic; create small adapter to compute per-POP quantiles and EWMA. Config: per-customer overrides for allowed variants, min_capacity, prefer_local. Metric outputs: decision_latency (ms), decision_confidence (0-1), degraded_reason tags.
acceptance_criteria: New pop-choice evaluator produces ranked POPs and fallback sequence for all incoming test traffic in staging
Decision metadata includes decision_confidence and degradations with reason codes
No result degradation for 99% of historical synthetic traffic runs compared to current baseline (latency regression <2%)
Hysteresis prevents oscillation: when introducing a synthetic transient spike, routing flips <1/min and returns to baseline within configured decay
Unit and integration tests for quantile adapter, link-penalty calculator, and composite-scoring logic
Documentation + runtime flags added and reviewed in design doc; rollout plan approved by SRE
updates: 2025-02-18: Ticket created with initial design sketch and goals (Asha).

2025-02-21: Implemented quantile adapter prototype to compute sliding-window p50/p95 per POP; pushed experimental job to staging metrics pipeline (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/pop-quantile-adapter/pull/12).

2025-02-25: First composite scorer draft checked in. Alpha coefficients set to alpha=0.6 beta=0.3 gamma=0.1 for initial tests. Observed edge case where small bursts cause p95 spikes — added hysteresis idea (Brian).
2025-02-27: SRE review session: agreed to add packet-loss EWMA with 30s half-life and cap link_penalty to avoid overwhelming latency signal (notes: confluence.redwood.ai/pop-choice/2025-02-27).

2025-03-01: Integration work started to surface decision metadata on /routing/decide API; schema provisional. Running A/B comparing baseline region-decider with new optimizer on 10% of staging traffic.

2025-03-02: Observed a regression in tail latency for a high-rt request cohort under the alpha=0.6 config. Lowered alpha to 0.5 and added request-size normalization to latency_cost calculation. Marking for in-depth evaluation in next cycle.
